name: Reach Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Reach Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of electromagnetic brakes, precision transmission components, and harmonic reducers in China and internationally. The company offers miniature harmonic, double circular spline harmonic, brake-integrated harmonic, plastic harmonic, ultra-thin harmonic, collaborative harmonic, hat-shaped standard harmonic, and cup-shaped standard harmonic reducers. It also provides server motor, joint module, crane hoist, aerial work platform, forklift, micro motor, scooter, wind power, elevator, and stereo brakes, as well as garden equipment brakes and clutches, and electronic accessories; intelligent assisted driving products; locking assemblies, …
